title: Business Analyst - Riyadh
reasons: keywords: strategy, consulting, market research, benchmarking, growth, stakeholder, problem solving, analytics +3
description:
Are you a motivated and analytical professional looking to build a career in strategy consulting? Join our team in Riyadh as a Business Analyst and take on a key role in solving complex business challenges, developing strategic insights, and delivering high-impact solutions for leading organizations. Collaborate with project teams on strategic assignments for leading companies across various industries Conduct in-depth market research, data analysis, and benchmarking to support project objectives Analyze complex business problems and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations Develop presentations, reports, and other client deliverables to communicate key findings and strategic recommendations Participate in client meetings, interviews, and workshops to gather information, validate hypotheses, and support problem-solving Take ownership of workstreams and contribute to the development of strategic plans, operating models, and organizational redesigns Support quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and performance improvement

Bachelors Degree in Business Administration, STEM, Data Analytics Strong academic record 1–2 years of relevant experience in business analysis, strategy consulting, management consulting, or a related field Demonstrated analytical, structured problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills Strong ability to analyze data, identify insights, and translate findings into actionable recommendations Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization or analytical tools is a plus Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within tight deadlines Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with clients and senior team members Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and team-oriented environment Proactive, driven, and intellectually curious, with a strong ownership mindset Adaptable and receptive to feedback, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement Strong organizational and time-management skills with a high level of attention to detail Ability to think commercially and make data-driven decisions Confident, personable, and professional demeanor with a positive attitude and sense of humor

Start Date: January 2027
